local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--// ASSETLER
local PHOTO_ID = "rbxassetid://131044310716749"

local JUMPSCARE_IMAGE = "rbxassetid://120214878170512"
local JUMPSCARE_SOUND = "rbxassetid://74464434454195"

--// GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SCTeamGUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

--// ANA PANEL
local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 405)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0.5, -202)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.ClipsDescendants = true
frame.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
corner.Parent = frame

--// ARKA PLAN
local bg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
bg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bg.Image = PHOTO_ID
bg.ImageTransparency = 0.35
bg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
bg.ZIndex = 0
bg.Parent = frame

local bgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
bgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
bgCorner.Parent = bg

local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
overlay.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
overlay.BorderSizePixel = 0
overlay.ZIndex = 1
overlay.Parent = frame

--// TITLE BAR
local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 18)
titleBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.ZIndex = 5
titleBar.Parent = frame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "SC TEAM GUI"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.TextSize = 19
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.ZIndex = 6
title.Parent = titleBar

--// KÜÇÜLT
local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 36)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 6)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
toggle.Text = "−"
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
toggle.TextSize = 25
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggle.ZIndex = 7
toggle.Parent = titleBar

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggle

--// BUTON ALANI
local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -70)
holder.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 58)
holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
holder.ZIndex = 5
holder.Parent = frame

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 9)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.Parent = holder

local function createButton(text)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
	b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.Text = text
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.TextSize = 16
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.ZIndex = 6
	b.Parent = holder

	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	c.Parent = b

	return b
end

--// PARTICLE
local particleButton = createButton("PARTICLE")

particleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local char = plr.Character
		local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if head then
			local old = head:FindFirstChild("SCPhotoParticle")
			if old then
				old:Destroy()
			end

			local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
			attachment.Name = "SCPhotoParticle"
			attachment.Parent = head

			local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			emitter.Texture = PHOTO_ID
			emitter.Rate = 12
			emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
			emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
			emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
			emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
			emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-100, 100)
			emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.8)
			emitter.Parent = attachment
		end
	end
end)

--// DECAL
local decalButton = createButton("DECAL")

decalButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			for _, face in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do

				local old = obj:FindFirstChild("SCPhoto_" .. face.Name)

				if old then
					old:Destroy()
				end

				local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
				decal.Name = "SCPhoto_" .. face.Name
				decal.Texture = PHOTO_ID
				decal.Face = face
				decal.Parent = obj
			end
		end
	end
end)

--// SKYBOX
local skyboxButton = createButton("SKYBOX")

skyboxButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	local old = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SCTeamSky")

	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
	sky.Name = "SCTeamSky"

	sky.SkyboxBk = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxDn = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxFt = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxLf = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxRt = PHOTO_ID
	sky.SkyboxUp = PHOTO_ID

	sky.CelestialBodiesShown = false
	sky.Parent = Lighting
end)

--// JUMPSCARE
local jumpscareButton = createButton("JUMPSCARE")

jumpscareButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	local old = gui:FindFirstChild("SCJumpscare")

	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end

	local jumpscare = Instance.new("Frame")
	jumpscare.Name = "SCJumpscare"
	jumpscare.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	jumpscare.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	jumpscare.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	jumpscare.BorderSizePixel = 0
	jumpscare.ZIndex = 100
	jumpscare.Parent = gui

	local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	image.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	image.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	image.Image = JUMPSCARE_IMAGE
	image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	image.ZIndex = 101
	image.Parent = jumpscare

	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "JumpscareSound"
	sound.SoundId = JUMPSCARE_SOUND
	sound.Volume = 1
	sound.Parent = jumpscare

	sound:Play()

	if not sound.IsLoaded then
		sound.Loaded:Wait()
	end

	if sound.TimeLength > 0 then
		task.wait(sound.TimeLength)
	else
		sound.Ended:Wait()
	end

	if jumpscare and jumpscare.Parent then
		jumpscare:Destroy()
	end
end)

--// PP EFEKTİ
local ppButton = createButton("PP")

local ppEffect = nil
local ppConnection = nil
local ppRunning = false

local function stopPP()
	ppRunning = false

	if ppConnection then
		ppConnection:Disconnect()
		ppConnection = nil
	end

	if ppEffect then
		ppEffect:Destroy()
		ppEffect = nil
	end
end

ppButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	-- Açıkken tekrar basılırsa kapat
	if ppRunning then
		stopPP()
		return
	end

	ppRunning = true

	ppEffect = Instance.new("Frame")
	ppEffect.Name = "SCPP"
	ppEffect.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	ppEffect.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
	ppEffect.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ppEffect.ZIndex = 90
	ppEffect.Parent = gui

	--// BÜYÜK FOTOĞRAF
	local bigPhoto = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	bigPhoto.Name = "SunPhoto"
	bigPhoto.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 170)

	bigPhoto.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	bigPhoto.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.45, 0)

	bigPhoto.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	bigPhoto.Image = JUMPSCARE_IMAGE
	bigPhoto.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	bigPhoto.ZIndex = 92
	bigPhoto.Parent = ppEffect

	local bigCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	bigCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	bigCorner.Parent = bigPhoto

	--// FOTOĞRAFIN ETRAFINDAKİ ÇİZGİ
	local orbit = Instance.new("Frame")
	orbit.Name = "Orbit"
	orbit.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(250, 250)

	orbit.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	orbit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 115, 1, -115)

	orbit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	orbit.ZIndex = 91
	orbit.Parent = ppEffect

	local orbitCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	orbitCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	orbitCorner.Parent = orbit

	local orbitStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	orbitStroke.Thickness = 3
	orbitStroke.Transparency = 0.15
	orbitStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	orbitStroke.Parent = orbit

	--// KÜÇÜK DÜNYA
	local smallPhoto = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	smallPhoto.Name = "OrbitPhoto"
	smallPhoto.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52)

	smallPhoto.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

	smallPhoto.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	smallPhoto.Image = JUMPSCARE_IMAGE
	smallPhoto.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
	smallPhoto.ZIndex = 95
	smallPhoto.Parent = orbit

	local smallCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	smallCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	smallCorner.Parent = smallPhoto

	--// SOL ALT TARAFA HAREKET
	local moveTween = TweenService:Create(
		bigPhoto,
		TweenInfo.new(
			3,
			Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,
			Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
		),
		{
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 115, 1, -115)
		}
	)

	moveTween:Play()

	moveTween.Completed:Wait()

	if not ppRunning then
		return
	end

	--// YÖRÜNGE DÖNÜŞÜ
	local angle = 0

	ppConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)

		if not ppRunning then
			return
		end

		angle = angle + (deltaTime * 100)

		local radians = math.rad(angle)

		local radius = 125

		local x = math.cos(radians) * radius
		local y = math.sin(radians) * radius

		smallPhoto.Position = UDim2.new(
			0.5,
			x,
			0.5,
			y
		)
	end)
end)

--// CLEAR ALL
local clearButton = createButton("CLEAR ALL")

clearButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	-- Particle
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		local char = plr.Character
		local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if head then

			local particle = head:FindFirstChild("SCPhotoParticle")

			if particle then
				particle:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	-- Decal
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then

			for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do

				if child:IsA("Decal")
					and string.sub(child.Name, 1, 8) == "SCPhoto_" then

					child:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Skybox
	local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("SCTeamSky")

	if sky then
		sky:Destroy()
	end

	-- Jumpscare
	local jumpscare = gui:FindFirstChild("SCJumpscare")

	if jumpscare then
		jumpscare:Destroy()
	end

	-- PP
	stopPP()
end)

--// SÜRÜKLEME
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos
local dragInput

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = frame.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()

			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end

		end)
	end
end)

titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if input == dragInput and dragging then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		frame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

--// KÜÇÜLT / AÇ
local minimized = false
local savedSize = frame.Size

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	if not minimized then

		minimized = true

		savedSize = frame.Size
		holder.Visible = false

		frame.Size = UDim2.new(
			savedSize.X.Scale,
			savedSize.X.Offset,
			0,
			48
		)

		toggle.Text = "+"

	else

		minimized = false

		frame.Size = savedSize
		holder.Visible = true

		toggle.Text = "−"
	end
end)

scripts.script:
-- BACKROOMS INFINITE MAZE LOADER SCRIPT (V4 - REAL FALL GRAVITY)
-- Sistem pembersihan ultra pantas, pemadaman Baseplate, dan jatuhan graviti rawak supaya pemain tidak bertindih di atas kepala.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- KONFIGURASI BACKROOMS
local CHUNK_SIZE = 40 
local WALL_HEIGHT = 12
local WALL_THICKNESS = 1
local RENDER_DISTANCE = 3 

local generatedChunks = {} 
local backroomsFolder

-- 1. PEMBERSIHAN MAP LAMA & BASEPLATE
local function clearMap()
    debug.profilebegin("FastMapClear")
    local children = workspace:GetChildren()
    for i = 1, #children do
        local obj = children[i]
        if not obj:IsA("Camera") and not obj:IsA("Terrain") then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    debug.profileend()
    print("✓ Map lama dan Baseplate dipadamkan!")
end

-- Fungsi Matematik Deterministik Maze
local function getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, wallType)
    local seed = math.sin(chunkX * 12.9898 + chunkZ * 78.233) * 43758.5453
    local pseudoRandom = seed - math.floor(seed)
    if wallType == "North" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "West" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "CenterH" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    if wallType == "CenterV" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    return false
end

-- 2. PENJANAAN CHUNK
local function generateChunk(chunkX, chunkZ)
    local chunkKey = chunkX .. "," .. chunkZ
    if generatedChunks[chunkKey] then return end 
    generatedChunks[chunkKey] = true

    local chunkModel = Instance.new("Model")
    chunkModel.Name = "Chunk_" .. chunkKey
    chunkModel.Parent = backroomsFolder

    local worldX = chunkX * CHUNK_SIZE
    local worldZ = chunkZ * CHUNK_SIZE

    -- Lantai Karpet Kuning Lembap
    local floor = Instance.new("Part")
    floor.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    floor.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, -0.5, worldZ)
    floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(185, 170, 115) 
    floor.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
    floor.Anchored = true
    floor.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Siling Beton
    local ceiling = Instance.new("Part")
    ceiling.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    ceiling.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT + 0.5, worldZ)
    ceiling.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 195, 180)
    ceiling.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
    ceiling.Anchored = true
    ceiling.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Fungsi Dinding
    local function createWall(size, position)
        local wall = Instance.new("Part")
        wall.Size = size
        wall.Position = position
        wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(215, 200, 130) 
        wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        wall.Anchored = true
        wall.Parent = chunkModel
    end

    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "North") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ - CHUNK_SIZE/2))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "West") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterH") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/4, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterV") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE/2), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ + CHUNK_SIZE/4))
    end

    -- Lampu Neon
    local lightPart = Instance.new("Part")
    lightPart.Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.2, 2)
    lightPart.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT - 0.1, worldZ)
    lightPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 230)
    lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    lightPart.Anchored = true
    lightPart.Parent = chunkModel

    local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    pointLight.Brightness = 2
    pointLight.Range = 30
    pointLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200)
    pointLight.Parent = lightPart

    if math.random() > 0.7 then
        task.spawn(function()
            while task.wait(math.random(3, 10)) do
                if not lightPart or not lightPart.Parent then break end
                pointLight.Enabled = false
                lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                task.wait(math.random(0.1, 0.4))
                pointLight.Enabled = true
                lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- 3. LOAD MAP BACKROOM UTAMA
local function createBackroomsMap()
    backroomsFolder = Instance.new("Model")
    backroomsFolder.Name = "Backrooms_Infinite"
    backroomsFolder.Parent = workspace
    
    local spawnPart = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
    spawnPart.Name = "MainSpawn"
    spawnPart.Size = Vector3.new(15, 1, 15)
    spawnPart.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
    spawnPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 140, 100)
    spawnPart.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
    spawnPart.Anchored = true
    spawnPart.CanCollide = true
    spawnPart.Parent = backroomsFolder

    for x = -2, 2 do
        for z = -2, 2 do
            generateChunk(x, z)
        end
    end
    
    Lighting.Brightness = 0.8
    Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 75, 60)
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    Lighting.ClockTime = 12
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
    
    local ambientSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    ambientSound.Name = "FluorescentHum"
    ambientSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9069509268" 
    ambientSound.Volume = 0.4
    ambientSound.Looped = true
    ambientSound.Parent = workspace
    ambientSound:Play()
    
    print("✓ Backrooms Map Yuklendi!")
end

-- 4. TELEPORTASI DAN JATUH DENGAN GRAVITI REALISTIK (Anti-Bertindih)
local function teleportPlayerWithGravity(character)
    local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    
    if rootPart and humanoid then
        -- MENGALIS RENTIK: Membuat kedudukan X dan Z rawak (jejari 4 stud) di kawasan spawn
        -- Ketinggian (Y = 10.5) ditetapkan ngam di bawah siling supaya mereka jatuh bebas secara realistik
        local offsetX = math.random(-4, 4)
        local offsetZ = math.random(-4, 4)
        local targetPosition = Vector3.new(offsetX, 10.5, offsetZ)
        
        -- Pindahkan watak dengan PivotTo ke udara
        character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(targetPosition))
        
        -- Memaksa fizik Roblox mengemas kini jatuhan momentum dengan serta-merta
        task.defer(function()
            if rootPart then
                rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -25, 0) -- Momentum awal jatuhan laju ke bawah karpet
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- Teleport untuk semua pemain sedia ada
local function respawnPlayers()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            teleportPlayerWithGravity(player.Character)
        end
    end
end

BxB.Ware | Clean Fly & Smart Noclip (Mobile & PC)
Tired of clunky scripts that break your character’s joints or fling you into the void? BxB.Ware is built from scratch with proper physics handling and clean UI layout. Lightweight, zero lag, and won't crash when you re-execute.

Features
Smooth Camera Fly: Fly wherever you look. Includes mobile-friendly Up/Down touch paddles and a 1–20x speed stepper.

Smart Anti-Void Noclip: Phase through walls safely. It detects the floor so you don't drop into the void or get stuck in terrain.

Physics Arbitration: Run Fly + Noclip at the same time without jittering or fighting gravity vectors.

Zero-Death Teardown: Turn features off or close the GUI without your character randomly dying, getting flung, or exploding.

Keybind Manager (⚙ Menu): Rebind on the fly or clear keybinds entirely ([E] for Fly, [V] for Noclip by default).

Minimalist UI: Draggable, minimizable, with a live FPS & Ping counter. Responsive layout that adapts to what you have enabled.

Fully Universal: Tested and working seamlessly across PC and Mobile executors.

local fly=false
local flySpd=50
local flyC,flyBV,flyBG
local flyAnimTrack

local function stopFly()
    fly=false
    if flyAnimTrack then pcall(function() flyAnimTrack:Stop() end) flyAnimTrack=nil end
    if flyC then flyC:Disconnect() flyC=nil end
    local ch=LP.Character
    if ch then
        local hrp=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then hrp.Anchored=false end
        local hm=ch:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if hm then hm.PlatformStand=false end
    end
end

local function startFly()
    local ch = getCh()
    local hrp = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hm = ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    hm.PlatformStand = true
    hrp.Anchored = true
    local animator = hm:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://507766666"
        local track = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        track.Looped = true
        track:Play()
        flyAnimTrack = track
    end
    local plr = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local plrControls
    local ok2, res = pcall(function() return require(plr.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.ControlModule) end)
    if ok2 then plrControls = res end
    flyC = R.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not fly then return end
        if not plrControls then return end
        local h2 = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not h2 then return end
        local moveDir = plrControls:GetMoveVector()
        local camCF = C.CFrame
        local newPos = h2.Position
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            local camRotation = camCF - camCF.Position
            local direction = camRotation * moveDir
            newPos = newPos + direction.Unit * (flySpd * 0.05)
        end
        h2.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, newPos + camCF.LookVector)
    end)
end

local function isTeammate(p)
    if not teamCheckOn then return false end
    if not LP.Team then return false end
    if not p.Team then return false end
    return LP.Team == p.Team
end

local function getBodyPart(char, boneName)
    if not char then return nil end
    if boneName == "Head" then
        return char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    else
        return char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    end
end

local function isVisibleFromCamera(part)
    if not wallCheckOn then return true end
    if not part then return false end
    local cam = C
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local targetPos = part.Position
    local dir = (targetPos - origin)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LP.Character}
    local result = W:Raycast(origin, dir, params)
    if not result then return true end
    return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
end

local function getPriorityPlayer(players)
    if #players == 0 then return nil end
    if aimPriority == "Nearest" then
        local myHrp = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return players[1] end
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in pairs(players) do
            local hrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local d = (hrp.Position - myHrp.Position).Magnitude
                if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = p, d end
            end
        end
        return best
    elseif aimPriority == "Lowest HP" then
        local best, bestHP = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in pairs(players) do
            local hm = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hm and hm.Health < bestHP then best, bestHP = p, hm.Health end
        end
        return best
    elseif aimPriority == "Closest to Crosshair" then
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        local center = C.ViewportSize / 2
        for _, p in pairs(players) do
            local part = getBodyPart(p.Character, aimBone)
            if part then
                local sp, onScreen = C:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = p, d end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    return players[1]
end

local function getPlayersInFov()
    local list = {}
    local center = C.ViewportSize / 2
    for _, p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP and p.Character then
            if not isTeammate(p) then
                local part = getBodyPart(p.Character, aimBone)
                if part and isVisibleFromCamera(part) then
                    local sp, onScreen = C:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                    if onScreen then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                        if d <= aimFov then
                            table.insert(list, p)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return list
end

if aimPredictionOn then

mkLabel(CombatPage,"HITBOX")

local hitboxOn = false
local hitboxSize = 5
local hitboxConns = {}

local function restoreHitbox(p)
    local char = p.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp and hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
        hrp.Size = hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig")
    end
    for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
            part.Size = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig")
            local masslessAttr = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigMassless")
            local canCollideAttr = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigCanCollide")
            if masslessAttr ~= nil then part.Massless = masslessAttr end
            if canCollideAttr ~= nil then part.CanCollide = canCollideAttr end
        end
    end
end

local function applyHitbox(p)
    if p == LP then return end
    local char = p.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then
        if not hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
            hrp:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig", hrp.Size)
        end
        hrp.Size = hrp:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") + Vector3.new(hitboxSize, hitboxSize, hitboxSize)
    end
    for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= hrp and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            if not part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig") then
                part:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig", part.Size)
                part:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigMassless", part.Massless)
                part:SetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrigCanCollide", part.CanCollide)
            end
            local orig = part:GetAttribute("RichieHitboxOrig")
            part.Size = orig + Vector3.new(hitboxSize, hitboxSize, hitboxSize)
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.Massless = true
        end
    end
end

mkTog(CombatPage,"Hitbox Expander",function(on)
    hitboxOn = on
    for _, c in pairs(hitboxConns) do c:Disconnect() end
    hitboxConns = {}

do
mkLabel(WorldPage,"WEATHER (Can Cause lag and fps drops)")

local weatherInstances = {}
local weatherConn = nil
local weatherParts = {}
local weatherPartSpeed = 0
local weatherPartSway = false
local thunderActive = false
local rainSound = nil

local function track(inst)
    table.insert(weatherInstances, inst)
    return inst
end

local function spawnLightningBolt(basePos)
    local boltFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    boltFolder.Name = "RichieBolt"
    boltFolder.Parent = W
    track(boltFolder)
    local startPos = basePos + Vector3.new(math.random(-120,120), 260, math.random(-120,120))
    local endPos = basePos + Vector3.new(math.random(-40,40), 25, math.random(-40,40))
    local segments = 14
    local points = {}
    for i = 0, segments do
        local t = i / segments
        local pos = startPos:Lerp(endPos, t)
        if i > 0 and i < segments then
            pos = pos + Vector3.new(math.random(-8,8), 0, math.random(-8,8))
        end
        table.insert(points, pos)
    end
    for i = 1, #points - 1 do
        local p1 = points[i]
        local p2 = points[i+1]
        local mid = (p1 + p2) / 2
        local dist = (p2 - p1).Magnitude
        local seg = Instance.new("Part")
        seg.Anchored = true
        seg.CanCollide = false
        seg.CanQuery = false
        seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        seg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230,230,255)
        seg.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, dist)
        seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, p2)
        seg.Parent = boltFolder
    end
    task.delay(0.25, function()
        if boltFolder and boltFolder.Parent then boltFolder:Destroy() end
    end)
end

local function stopWeather()
    thunderActive = false
    if weatherConn then weatherConn:Disconnect() weatherConn=nil end
    for _, inst in pairs(weatherInstances) do
        if inst and inst.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                if inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then inst:Clear() end
                inst:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    weatherInstances = {}
    weatherParts = {}
    weatherPartSpeed = 0
    weatherPartSway = false
    if rainSound then rainSound:Stop() rainSound:Destroy() rainSound=nil end
    L.FogStart = origFogStart
    L.FogEnd = origFogEnd
    L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(192,192,192)
    L.Brightness = origBright
    local atm = L:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
    if atm then atm.Density = 0.3 atm.Haze = 0 end
end

local function buildRain(hrp, count, isSnow)
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = isSnow and "RichieSnow" or "RichieRain"
    folder.Parent = W
    track(folder)
    local base = hrp.Position
    for i = 1, count do
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        if isSnow then
            p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
            p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            p.Transparency = 0.15
        else
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 3)
p.Orientation = Vector3.new(90, 0, 0)
            p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180,200,255)
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Transparency = 0.35
        end
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.Parent = folder
        p.Position = Vector3.new(
            base.X + math.random(-200,200),
            base.Y + math.random(20,200),
            base.Z + math.random(-200,200)
        )
        table.insert(weatherParts, p)
    end
    weatherPartSpeed = isSnow and 0.6 or 8
    weatherPartSway = isSnow
end

local function startWeather(kind)
    stopWeather()
    if kind == "Clear" then notify("Weather: Clear") return end
    local ch = LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local hrp = ch:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    if not hrp then notify("Character not ready") return end

    if kind == "Fog" then
        L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,205)
        L.FogStart = 0
        L.FogEnd = 60
        local atm = L:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
        if atm then atm.Density = 1 atm.Haze = 5 atm.Glare = 0 atm.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,205) end
        notify("Weather: Fog")
        return
    end

    if kind == "Rain" or kind == "Thunder" then
        buildRain(hrp, 250, false)
        rainSound = Instance.new("Sound")
        rainSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9064263922"
        rainSound.Volume = 0.6
        rainSound.Looped = true
        rainSound.Parent = SG
        rainSound:Play()
        track(rainSound)
        L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(120,130,140)
        L.FogStart = 0
        L.FogEnd = 250

        if kind == "Thunder" then
            L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,40)
            L.FogEnd = 180
            L.Brightness = 0.4
            thunderActive = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while thunderActive do
                    task.wait(math.random(3,7))
                    if not thunderActive then break end
                    local c = LP.Character
                    local h = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if h then spawnLightningBolt(h.Position) end
                    local flash = Instance.new("Frame")
                    flash.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                    flash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
                    flash.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    flash.ZIndex = 999
                    flash.Parent = SG
                    L.Brightness = 7
                    task.wait(0.06)
                    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
                    L.Brightness = 2.5
                    task.wait(0.06)
                    flash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                    L.Brightness = 5
                    task.wait(0.05)
                    flash:Destroy()
                    L.Brightness = 0.4
                    local thunder = Instance.new("Sound")
                    thunder.SoundId = "rbxassetid://139968319088532"
                    thunder.Volume = 1
                    thunder.Parent = SG
                    thunder:Play()
                    task.spawn(function()
                        task.wait(6)
                        if thunder then thunder:Destroy() end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
        notify("Weather: "..kind)
    elseif kind == "Snow" then
        buildRain(hrp, 320, true)
        L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(220,225,235)
        L.FogStart = 0
        L.FogEnd = 300
        notify("Weather: Snow")
    end

    weatherConn = R.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local c = LP.Character
        if not c then return end
        local h = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not h then return end
        local base = h.Position
        local sway = tick()
        for _, p in pairs(weatherParts) do
            if p and p.Parent then
                local np = p.Position - Vector3.new(0, weatherPartSpeed, 0)
                if weatherPartSway then
                    np = np + Vector3.new(math.sin(sway + p.Position.X) * 0.05, 0, math.cos(sway + p.Position.Z) * 0.05)
                end
                if np.Y < base.Y - 20 then
                    np = Vector3.new(
                        base.X + math.random(-200,200),
                        base.Y + 150,
                        base.Z + math.random(-200,200)
                    )
                elseif (np - base).Magnitude > 350 then
                    np = Vector3.new(
                        base.X + math.random(-200,200),
                        base.Y + 150,
                        base.Z + math.random(-200,200)
                    )
                end
                p.Position = np
            end
        end
    end)
end

mkBtn(WorldPage,"Rain",function() startWeather("Rain") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Snow",function() startWeather("Snow") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Fog",function() startWeather("Fog") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Thunder",function() startWeather("Thunder") end)
mkBtn(WorldPage,"Clear Weather",function() startWeather("Clear") end)
_G.richieWeatherCleanup = stopWeather

end

local CONFIG_FOLDER="richiehub_configs"
local CONFIG_INDEX=CONFIG_FOLDER.."/index.txt"
pcall(function()
    if not isfolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) then makefolder(CONFIG_FOLDER) end
end)

local function getConfigList()
    local list={}
    pcall(function()
        if isfile(CONFIG_INDEX) then
            local content=readfile(CONFIG_INDEX)
            for name in content:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
                table.insert(list, name)
            end
        end
    end)
    return list
end

local function saveConfigList(list)
    pcall(function()
        writefile(CONFIG_INDEX, table.concat(list, "\n"))
    end)
end

local saveInp=mkInp(ConfigPage,"Enter config name...")

mkBtn(ConfigPage,"Save Config",function()
    local name=saveInp.Text
    if not name or name=="" then
        saveInp.Text="Name required!"
        return
    end
    local data={}
    for k,v in pairs(savedValues) do data[k]=v end
    local jsonStr="{"
    local first=true
    for k,v in pairs(data) do
        if not first then jsonStr=jsonStr.."," end
        jsonStr=jsonStr..'"'..k..'":'..tostring(v)
        first=false
    end
    jsonStr=jsonStr.."}"
    pcall(function()
        writefile(CONFIG_FOLDER.."/"..name..".cfg", jsonStr)
        local list=getConfigList()
        local found=false
        for _,n in pairs(list) do if n==name then found=true break end end
        if not found then
            table.insert(list, name)
            saveConfigList(list)
        end
    end)
    saveInp.Text="Saved: "..name
end)

local function resolveTarget(q)
    if not q or q=="" then return nil,"" end
    q=q:lower()
    for _,p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=LP and p.Name:lower()==q then return p,p.Name end
    end
    local m={}
    for _,p in pairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=LP and p.Name:lower():sub(1,#q)==q then table.insert(m,p) end
    end
    if #m==1 then return m[1],m[1].Name end
    if #m==0 then return nil,"" end
    return nil,"user not found."
end

mkBtn(targetContainer,"Fling Target",function()
    local tg = _G.richieTarget
    if not tg or not tg.Character then notifyRed("No target selected") return end
    local myCh = LP.Character
    if not myCh then return end
    local myHum = myCh:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local myRoot = myHum and myHum.RootPart
    if not myHum or not myRoot then notifyRed("Character not ready") return end
    local TChar = tg.Character
    if not TChar then notifyRed("Target has no character") return end
    local THum = TChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local TRoot = THum and THum.RootPart
    local THead = TChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local Acc = TChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory")
    local Handle = Acc and Acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not TChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") then notifyRed("Target invalid") return end
    local oldFPDH = W.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
    local oldPos = myRoot.CFrame
    notify("Flinging "..tg.Name.."...")
    local FPos = function(BasePart, Pos, Ang)
        myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang
        myCh:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(BasePart.Position) * Pos * Ang)
        myRoot.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e7 * 10, 9e7)
        myRoot.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
    end
    local SFBasePart = function(BasePart)
        local TimeToWait = 2
        local Time = tick()
        local Angle = 0
        repeat
            if myRoot and THum then
                if BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
                    Angle = Angle + 100
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection * BasePart.Velocity.Magnitude / 1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0) + THum.MoveDirection, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(Angle), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                else
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THum.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, -THum.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, THum.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                    FPos(BasePart, CFrame.new(0, -1.5, 0), CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0))
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
        until Time + TimeToWait < tick()
        W.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
        local BV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        BV.Parent = myRoot
        BV.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        BV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
        pcall(function() myHum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false) end)
        -- if block removed
        -- removed
        -- removed
        BV:Destroy()
        pcall(function() myHum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true) end)
        pcall(function() myHum:ChangeState("GettingUp") end)
        for _, part in pairs(myCh:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Velocity = Vector3.new()
                part.RotVelocity = Vector3.new()
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
pcall(function()
    myHum.PlatformStand = false
    myHum.Sit = false
    myHum.WalkSpeed = savedValues["speed"] or 16
    myHum.JumpPower = savedValues["jump"] or 50
    myHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
end)
myRoot.Anchored = true
myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
myRoot.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
myRoot.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)

pcall(function() myCh:PivotTo(oldPos) end)
task.wait(0.15)
myRoot.Anchored = false

    end)

        keybindData[featureName] = nil
        btn.Text="+"
        btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
    end)

local function onKeyPress(input)
    if not listeningForKey then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    local key=input.KeyCode
    local btn=listeningBtn
    if unsupportedKeys[key] then
        btn.Text="Not Allowed"
        btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)
        task.wait(1)
        btn.Text="+"
        btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
        listeningForKey=nil
        listeningBtn=nil
        return
    end
    if key==Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
    for otherFeature, boundKey in pairs(keybindData) do
        if otherFeature ~= listeningForKey and boundKey == key then
            btn.Text="In Use"
            btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80)
            task.wait(1)
            btn.Text="+"
            btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,220,220)
            listeningForKey=nil
            listeningBtn=nil
            return
        end
    end
    keybindData[listeningForKey] = key
    btn.Text=key.Name
    btn.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(80,200,120)
    listeningForKey=nil
    listeningBtn=nil
end

U.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
    if listeningForKey then
        onKeyPress(input)
        return
    end
    for featureName, key in pairs(keybindData) do
        if input.KeyCode==key then
            if keybindTargets[featureName] then
                local tgt=keybindTargets[featureName]
                local current = _G.richieToggleState[featureName]
                if current == nil then current = false end
                local newState = not current
                _G.richieToggleState[featureName]=newState
                tgt.setState(newState)
                if tgt.onChange then tgt.onChange(newState) end
                notify(featureName .. ": " .. (newState and "ON" or "OFF"))
            elseif keybindButtons[featureName] then
                local info=keybindButtons[featureName]
                if info.fire then info.fire() end
                notify(featureName .. ": fired")
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- RSR STUDIO - SHOOTER PANEL ENHANCED

-- SETTINGS
--========================================================

    OpenKey = Enum.KeyCode.K,

    -- PVP
    AimAssist = false,
    AimKey = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
    AimKeyName = "RIGHT MOUSE",
    ESP = false,
    Tracers = false,
    FOVEnabled = true,
    FOV = 120,
    AimSmoothness = 0.15,
    Hitbox = 0,

    -- MOVEMENT
    SpeedEnabled = false,
    Speed = 16,
    FlyEnabled = false,
    FlySpeed = 50,
    SpinEnabled = false,
    SpinSpeed = 5,

    -- CAMERA / FIRST PERSON
    CameraFOV = 120,
    ArmsEnabled = false,
    ArmDistance = 0,

    -- VISUALS
    RainEnabled = true,
    MirrorEnabled = true,
    NeonAnimations = true,

    -- BETTER FPS
    BetterFPSEnabled = false,

    -- INVISIBILITY
    Invisible = false,

    -- COLORS
    ESPColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
    TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    FOVColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),

    GuiOpen = true,
    SoundsEnabled = true,
}

-- Roblox's native Camera.FieldOfView cannot exceed 120 degrees.
local NATIVE_FOV_MAX = 120

--========================================================
-- UI SOUNDS + PRESS ANIMATION
-- Change the Id values below to any sound you like,
-- e.g. "rbxassetid://123456789"
--========================================================

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local SoundIDs = {
    Click = {Id = "rbxasset://sounds/button.wav", Volume = 0.6},
    Toggle = {Id = "rbxasset://sounds/switch.wav", Volume = 0.6},
}

local function PlaySound(Name)
    if not Settings.SoundsEnabled then
        return
    end

    local Data = SoundIDs[Name]
    if not Data then
        return
    end

    local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    Sound.SoundId = Data.Id
    Sound.Volume = Data.Volume
    Sound.Parent = SoundService
    Sound:Play()

    task.delay(3, function()
        if Sound then
            Sound:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

-- Button shrinks when pressed, springs back on release, plays a click sound.
local function AddPressAnimation(Button, SoundName)
    local Scale = Button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale")
    Scale.Scale = 1
    Scale.Parent = Button

    Button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(
            Scale,

local function SwitchPage(Name)
    for PageName, Page in pairs(Pages) do
        local Show = PageName == Name
        if Show and not Page.Visible then
            Page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 18)
            Page.Visible = true
            TweenService:Create(
                Page,
                TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}
            ):Play()
        else
            Page.Visible = Show
        end
    end

    for TabName, Button in pairs(Tabs) do
        local Selected = TabName == Name
        TweenService:Create(
            Button,
            TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {
                BackgroundColor3 = Selected
                    and Color3.fromRGB(55, 65, 90)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 34),
                TextColor3 = Selected
                    and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    or Color3.fromRGB(160, 165, 180),
            }
        ):Play()
    end
end

    local Fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    local InitialPercent = math.clamp((Default - Min) / math.max(Max - Min, 0.0001), 0, 1)
    Fill.Size = UDim2.new(InitialPercent, 0, 1, 0)
    Fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 130, 255)
    Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Fill.ZIndex = 14
    Fill.Parent = Bar

    local FillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    FillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    FillCorner.Parent = Fill

    local Knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    Knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    Knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
    Knob.Position = UDim2.new(InitialPercent, 0, 0.5, 0)
    Knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 225, 255)
    Knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Knob.ZIndex = 15
    Knob.Parent = Bar

    local KnobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    KnobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    KnobCorner.Parent = Knob

    local Dragging = false
    local LastNumber = Default

    local function FormatNumber(Number)
        if Max - Min >= 10 then
            return math.floor(Number + 0.5)
        end
        return math.floor(Number * 100 + 0.5) / 100
    end

    local function SetValue(X)
        local Percent = math.clamp(
            (X - Bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(Bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1),
            0,
            1
        )

        local Number = FormatNumber(Min + (Max - Min) * Percent)
        LastNumber = Number
        local FinalPercent = math.clamp((Number - Min) / math.max(Max - Min, 0.0001), 0, 1)

        Fill.Size = UDim2.new(FinalPercent, 0, 1, 0)
        Knob.Position = UDim2.new(FinalPercent, 0, 0.5, 0)
        Value.Text = tostring(Number)
        Callback(Number)
    end

    Bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)
        if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            Dragging = true
            PlaySound("Click")
            TweenService:Create(
                Knob,
                TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)}
            ):Play()
            SetValue(Input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
        if Dragging and Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            SetValue(Input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(Input)
        if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            if Dragging then
                TweenService:Create(
                    Knob,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)}
                ):Play()
            end
            Dragging = false
        end
    end)

    Value.Text = tostring(LastNumber)
    Callback(LastNumber)
    return Holder
end

local function GetClosestTarget()
    local Closest = nil
    local ClosestDistance = math.huge

    local Center = Vector2.new(
        Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
        Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
    )

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local Character = Player.Character
            local Head = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local Position, Visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)

                if Visible and Position.Z > 0 then
                    local ScreenPosition = Vector2.new(Position.X, Position.Y)
                    local Distance = (ScreenPosition - Center).Magnitude

                    if Distance <= Settings.FOV and Distance < ClosestDistance then
                        ClosestDistance = Distance
                        Closest = Head
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return Closest
end

-- FLY
--========================================================

local FlyVelocity
local FlyConnection

local function StartFly()
    if FlyConnection then
        FlyConnection:Disconnect()
        FlyConnection = nil
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Root = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not Root then
        return
    end

    if FlyVelocity then
        FlyVelocity:Destroy()
    end

    FlyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    FlyVelocity.Name = "RSR_FlyVelocity"
    FlyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    FlyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    FlyVelocity.Parent = Root

    FlyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Settings.FlyEnabled or not Root.Parent then
            return
        end

        local Direction = Vector3.zero

        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            Direction += Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            Direction -= Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            Direction -= Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            Direction += Camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            Direction += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
            Direction -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        if Direction.Magnitude > 0 then
            Direction = Direction.Unit
        end

        FlyVelocity.Velocity = Direction * Settings.FlySpeed
    end)
end

local function StopFly()
    if FlyConnection then
        FlyConnection:Disconnect()
        FlyConnection = nil
    end

    if FlyVelocity then
        FlyVelocity:Destroy()
        FlyVelocity = nil
    end
end

local OriginalHeadSizes = {}

local function UpdateHeadHitbox(Player)
    if Player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    local Character = Player.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not Head or not Head:IsA("BasePart") then
        return
    end

    if not OriginalHeadSizes[Player] then
        OriginalHeadSizes[Player] = Head.Size
    end

    local OriginalSize = OriginalHeadSizes[Player]

    if Settings.Hitbox <= 0 then
        Head.Size = OriginalSize
        return
    end

    local Scale = 1 + (Settings.Hitbox * 0.35)
    Head.Size = Vector3.new(
        OriginalSize.X * Scale,
        OriginalSize.Y * Scale,
        OriginalSize.Z * Scale
    )
end

--========================================================
-- FIRST PERSON ARM DISTANCE
--========================================================

local ArmJointCache = {}

local function GetArmJoints(Character)
    local Joints = {}

    local UpperTorso = Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    if UpperTorso then
        local Left = UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder")
        local Right = UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder")
        if Left and Left:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Left)
        end
        if Right and Right:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Right)
        end
    end

    local Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if Torso then
        local Left = Torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder")
        local Right = Torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder")
        if Left and Left:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Left)
        end
        if Right and Right:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Right)
        end
    end

    return Joints
end

local function IsFirstPerson()
    if not Camera then
        return false
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local Head = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not Head then
        return false
    end

    return (Camera.CFrame.Position - Head.Position).Magnitude < 1.1
end

local function UpdateArmDistance()
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Joints = ArmJointCache[Character]
    if not Joints then
        Joints = GetArmJoints(Character)
        ArmJointCache[Character] = Joints
    end

    local Active = Settings.ArmsEnabled and IsFirstPerson()

    for _, Joint in ipairs(Joints) do
        if Joint.Parent then
            if not Joint:GetAttribute("RSR_OriginalCached") then
                Joint:SetAttribute("RSR_OriginalCached", true)
                Joint:SetAttribute("RSR_OriginalC0", tostring(Joint.C0))
            end

            -- Use a local Transform for a safer visual offset during first-person.
            if Active then
                local direction = Joint.Name:lower():find("left") and -1 or 1
                Joint.Transform = CFrame.new(direction * Settings.ArmDistance * 0.18, 0, -Settings.ArmDistance * 0.08)
            else
                Joint.Transform = CFrame.identity
            end
        end
    end
end

local InvisibleOriginals = {}

local function RememberInvisible(instance, property)
    InvisibleOriginals[instance] = InvisibleOriginals[instance] or {}
    if InvisibleOriginals[instance][property] == nil then
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return instance[property] end)
        if ok then
            InvisibleOriginals[instance][property] = value
        end
    end
end

local function ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(character)
    if not character then return end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            RememberInvisible(descendant, "LocalTransparencyModifier")
            pcall(function() descendant.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
        elseif descendant:IsA("Decal") or descendant:IsA("Texture") then
            RememberInvisible(descendant, "Transparency")
            pcall(function() descendant.Transparency = 1 end)
        end
    end
end

local function RemoveInvisibleFromCharacter(character)
    for instance, properties in pairs(InvisibleOriginals) do
        if instance and instance.Parent then
            for property, value in pairs(properties) do
                pcall(function() instance[property] = value end)
            end
        end
    end
    InvisibleOriginals = {}
end

local function UpdateInvisibility()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if Settings.Invisible then
        ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(character)
    else
        RemoveInvisibleFromCharacter(character)
    end
end

--========================================================
-- BETTER FPS OPTIMIZER
--========================================================

local FPSOriginals = {}
local FPSDescendantConnection
local FPSLightingOriginals = {
    GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
}

local function RememberProperty(Instance, Property)
    FPSOriginals[Instance] = FPSOriginals[Instance] or {}
    if FPSOriginals[Instance][Property] == nil then
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return Instance[Property]
        end)
        if ok then
            FPSOriginals[Instance][Property] = value
        end
    end
end

local function OptimizeInstance(Instance)
    if not Settings.BetterFPSEnabled then
        return
    end

    if Instance:IsA("Decal") or Instance:IsA("Texture") then
        RememberProperty(Instance, "Transparency")
        pcall(function()
            Instance.Transparency = 1
        end)
    elseif Instance:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or Instance:IsA("Trail") or Instance:IsA("Beam")
        or Instance:IsA("Smoke") or Instance:IsA("Fire") or Instance:IsA("Sparkles") then
        RememberProperty(Instance, "Enabled")
        pcall(function()
            Instance.Enabled = false
        end)
    elseif Instance:IsA("BloomEffect") or Instance:IsA("SunRaysEffect")
        or Instance:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or Instance:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect")
        or Instance:IsA("BlurEffect") then
        RememberProperty(Instance, "Enabled")
        pcall(function()
            Instance.Enabled = false
        end)
    end
end

local function EnableBetterFPS()
    Settings.BetterFPSEnabled = true
    FPSLightingOriginals.GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false

    for _, Descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        OptimizeInstance(Descendant)
    end

    for _, Descendant in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do
        OptimizeInstance(Descendant)
    end

    if FPSDescendantConnection then
        FPSDescendantConnection:Disconnect()
    end

    FPSDescendantConnection = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(Instance)
        task.defer(function()
            OptimizeInstance(Instance)
        end)
    end)
end

local function DisableBetterFPS()
    Settings.BetterFPSEnabled = false

    if FPSDescendantConnection then
        FPSDescendantConnection:Disconnect()
        FPSDescendantConnection = nil
    end

    for Instance, Properties in pairs(FPSOriginals) do
        if Instance and Instance.Parent then
            for Property, Value in pairs(Properties) do
                pcall(function()
                    Instance[Property] = Value
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    FPSOriginals = {}
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = FPSLightingOriginals.GlobalShadows
end

-- Watch the setting in case the UI callback is edited later.
local PreviousBetterFPS = Settings.BetterFPSEnabled
local PreviousInvisible = Settings.Invisible

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Settings.Invisible ~= PreviousInvisible then
        PreviousInvisible = Settings.Invisible
        UpdateInvisibility()
    elseif Settings.Invisible then
        ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Settings.BetterFPSEnabled ~= PreviousBetterFPS then
        PreviousBetterFPS = Settings.BetterFPSEnabled
        if Settings.BetterFPSEnabled then
            EnableBetterFPS()
        else
            DisableBetterFPS()
        end
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- MAIN LOOP
--========================================================

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera

    -- FOV circle
    FOVCircle.Visible = Settings.FOVEnabled
    if Settings.FOVEnabled then
        FOVCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Settings.FOV * 2, Settings.FOV * 2)
        FOVStroke.Color = Settings.FOVColor
        FOVGlow.Color = Settings.FOVColor
    end

    -- Neon / mirror animation
    if Settings.NeonAnimations then
        local Pulse = (math.sin(os.clock() * 3) + 1) / 2
        GlassStroke.Transparency = 0.58 + Pulse * 0.2
    else
        GlassStroke.Transparency = 0.72
    end

    Reflection.Visible = Settings.MirrorEnabled
    if Settings.MirrorEnabled and Settings.NeonAnimations then
        local sweep = (os.clock() % 2.8) / 2.8
        Reflection.Position = UDim2.new(-0.35 + sweep * 1.55, 0, -0.25, 0)
    end

    -- ESP: stays active after respawns while ON
    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if Settings.ESP then
                if not ESPObjects[Player] then
                    CreateESP(Player)
                else
                    local Object = ESPObjects[Player]

                    if Object.Highlight and Object.Highlight.Parent then
                        Object.Highlight.FillColor = Settings.ESPColor
                        Object.Highlight.OutlineColor = Settings.ESPColor
                    end

                    if Object.Billboard and Object.Billboard.Parent then
                        local Label = Object.Billboard:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                        if Label then
                            Label.TextColor3 = Settings.ESPColor
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                if ESPObjects[Player] then
                    RemoveESP(Player)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Tracers
    for Player, Line in pairs(Tracers) do
        if Line and Line.Parent then
            if not Settings.Tracers then
                Line.Visible = false
            else
                local Character = Player.Character
                local Root = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if Root then
                    local Position, Visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Root.Position)
                    if Visible then
                        local Start = Vector2.new(
                            Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                            Camera.ViewportSize.Y
                        )
                        local Finish = Vector2.new(Position.X, Position.Y)
                        local Difference = Finish - Start
                        local Length = Difference.Magnitude

                        Line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                            (Start.X + Finish.X) / 2,
                            (Start.Y + Finish.Y) / 2
                        )
                        Line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Length, 2)
                        Line.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(Difference.Y, Difference.X))
                        Line.BackgroundColor3 = Settings.TracerColor
                        Line.Visible = true
                    else
                        Line.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    Line.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Speed
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if Humanoid then
        if Settings.SpeedEnabled then
            Humanoid.WalkSpeed = Settings.Speed
        else
            Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        end
    end

    -- Spin
    if Settings.SpinEnabled and Character then
        local Root = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if Root then
            Root.CFrame = Root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(Settings.SpinSpeed), 0)
        end
    end

    -- Aim assist
    if Settings.AimAssist then
        local AimPressed = UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Settings.AimKey)
        if AimPressed then
            local Target = GetClosestTarget()
            if Target then
                local CameraPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position
                local TargetCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(CameraPosition, Target.Position)
                Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(TargetCFrame, Settings.AimSmoothness)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Local head visual
    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            UpdateHeadHitbox(Player)
        end
    end

    -- First-person arms
    UpdateArmDistance()
end)

--========================================================
-- FLY STATE
--========================================================

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Settings.FlyEnabled then
        if not FlyVelocity then
            StartFly()
        end
    else
        if FlyVelocity then
            StopFly()
        end
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- CAMERA FOV ENFORCEMENT
--========================================================

RunService:BindToRenderStep("RSR_CameraFOV", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
    if not Camera then
        return
    end

    local ActualFOV = math.clamp(Settings.CameraFOV, 80, NATIVE_FOV_MAX)
    if math.abs(Camera.FieldOfView - ActualFOV) > 0.05 then
        Camera.FieldOfView = ActualFOV
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- K = OPEN / CLOSE
--========================================================

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input, GameProcessed)
    if GameProcessed then
        return
    end

    if Input.KeyCode == Settings.OpenKey then
        Settings.GuiOpen = not Settings.GuiOpen
        PlaySound("Click")

        if Settings.GuiOpen then
            Main.Visible = true
            Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -400, 0.5, -235)
            MainScale.Scale = 0.9
            TweenService:Create(
                MainScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Scale = 1}
            ):Play()

            TweenService:Create(
                Main,
                TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -400, 0.5, -270),
                }
            ):Play()
        else
            TweenService:Create(
                Main,
                TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                {
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -400, 0.5, -235),
                }
            ):Play()

            TweenService:Create(
                MainScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                {Scale = 0.9}
            ):Play()

            task.delay(0.2, function()
                if not Settings.GuiOpen then
                    Main.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- RESPAWN
--========================================================

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Character)
    ArmJointCache[Character] = nil

    task.wait(0.6)

    if Settings.FlyEnabled then
        StartFly()
    end

    if Settings.ESP then
        ApplyESPToAll()
    end

    if Settings.Invisible then
        task.wait(0.15)
        UpdateInvisibility()
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- INITIAL STATE
--========================================================

if Settings.CameraFOV then
    Camera.FieldOfView = math.clamp(Settings.CameraFOV, 80, NATIVE_FOV_MAX)
end

Main.Visible = true

scripts.title: Teleport Tool
scripts.features:
Simple Tool Teleport Script Open Sourced.













#tool #teleport #noclip #fly #speed #jump
scripts.script:
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LP = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local char = LP.Character or LP.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
tool.Name = "Teleport Tool"
tool.RequiresHandle = false
tool.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("Backpack")

local function tp(pos)
	local ray = Cam:ViewportPointToRay(pos.X, pos.Y)
	local rp = RaycastParams.new()
	rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char, Cam}
	rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 5000, rp)
	local p = hit and hit.Position or ray.Origin + ray.Direction * 5000
	local _, y = root.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(0, y, 0)
end

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	if UIS.TouchEnabled then return end
	tp(UIS:GetMouseLocation())
end)

UIS.TouchTap:Connect(function(t, g)
	if g or tool.Parent ~= char or #t == 0 then return end
	tp(Vector2.new(t[1].X, t[1].Y))
end)

task.spawn(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end)

--==================================================
-- SELECTED PLAYER
--==================================================

local SelectedPlayer = nil

local function UpdateAvatar(player)

	if not player then
		Avatar.Image = ""
		return
	end

	local ok,url = pcall(function()

		return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
			player.UserId,
			Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
			Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100
		)

	end)

	if ok then
		Avatar.Image = url
	end

end

local function UpdatePreview()

	local name = SelectedPlayer and SelectedPlayer.DisplayName or "You"
	local msg = MessageBox.Text

	if msg == "" then
		msg = "..."
	end

	Preview.Text = "   " .. name .. ": " .. msg

end

MessageBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(UpdatePreview)

--==================================================
-- PLAYER LIST
--==================================================

local function RefreshPlayers()

	for _,child in ipairs(Dropdown:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("TextButton") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		Button.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,38)
		Button.BackgroundColor3 = PANEL
		Button.Text = "  " .. player.DisplayName .. "  @" .. player.Name
		Button.TextColor3 = WHITE
		Button.TextSize = 12
		Button.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
		Button.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		Button.ZIndex = 21
		Button.Parent = Dropdown

		Instance.new("UICorner",Button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,10)

		Button.Activated:Connect(function()

			SelectedPlayer = player

			PlayerButton.Text =
				"👤  " ..
				player.DisplayName

			PlayerButton.TextColor3 = WHITE

			UpdateAvatar(player)
			UpdatePreview()

			Dropdown.Visible = false

		end)

	end

	Dropdown.CanvasSize =
		UDim2.fromOffset(0,Layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 15)

end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(RefreshPlayers)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)

	if SelectedPlayer == player then
		SelectedPlayer = nil
		PlayerButton.Text = "👤  Select a player..."
		PlayerButton.TextColor3 = GRAY
		Avatar.Image = ""
		UpdatePreview()
	end

	RefreshPlayers()

end)

PlayerButton.Activated:Connect(function()

	RefreshPlayers()

	Dropdown.Visible = not Dropdown.Visible

end)

--==================================================

local function ShowMessage(target,message)

	if not target or message == "" then
		return
	end

	-- Chat window
	local channels = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")

	if channels then

		local general = channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")

		if general then

			general:DisplaySystemMessage(
				"<font color='#FFFFFF'>" ..
				target.DisplayName ..
				": " ..
				message ..
				"</font>"
			)

		end

	end

	-- Bubble
	local character = target.Character

	if character then

		local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")

		if head then
			TextChatService:DisplayBubble(head,message)
		end

	end

end

Send.Activated:Connect(function()

	-- Blank player = yourself
	local target = SelectedPlayer or LP
	local message = MessageBox.Text

	if message == "" then

		Send.Text = "⚠  TYPE A MESSAGE"

		task.wait(.8)

		Send.Text = "⚡  SEND TO CHAT + BUBBLE"

		return
	end

	ShowMessage(target,message)

	MessageBox.Text = ""

	Send.Text = "✓  SENT"

	TweenService:Create(
		Send,
		TweenInfo.new(.12),
		{Size = UDim2.new(1,-45,0,48)}
	):Play()

	task.wait(.15)

	TweenService:Create(
		Send,
		TweenInfo.new(.12),
		{Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,0,55)}
	):Play()

	task.wait(.5)

	Send.Text = "⚡  SEND TO CHAT + BUBBLE"

end)

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING — MOBILE + PC
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

Top.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Main.Position

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if not dragging then
		return
	end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		Main.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)

	end

end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false

	end

end)
